mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at overcast skies and 35 degrees near Reddan Soccer Park. There is an ISS pass scheduled for tonight, though heavy clouds mean you won't be able to see it.

In city news, candidate information packets for the 2027 Spring Election are officially available at the City Clerk's office for all four aldermanic districts. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed out by December 15th, with the first installment due on January 31st.

Local events are packed this week. Today, stop by Lake Lou-ee for pizza and a pitcher or enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow features Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, and on Saturday, ART House 360 hosts The Crafty Fair.
In police news, on a Monday earlier this month, an officer pulled over a swerving vehicle on Highway 18/151, leading to the arrest of a driver for a third-offence O W I.
Over at Culver's, today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The restaurant is open until 10:00 PM tonight, so stop by and grab a scoop.
